title: Included Monthly Transaction Allowances and Overage Rates
content:
Each tier of the Corporate Travel Programmes carries a number of booking transactions inside its subscription for each month, and publishes a charge for each booking transaction beyond that allowance.

| Programme tier | Booking transactions included each month | Charge for each transaction beyond the allowance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Business Starter Programme | 10 | 4.50 USD |
| Business Team Programme | 50 | 4.00 USD |
| Business Pro Programme | 250 | 3.25 USD |
| Business Enterprise Programme | 1200 | 2.50 USD |
| Business Enterprise Plus Programme | 5000 | 1.75 USD |
| Business Global Programme | 20000 | 1.00 USD |

## Notes

1. The included allowance widens sharply across the tiers, from 10 transactions a month on the Business Starter Programme through 50, 250, 1200 and 5000 to 20000 on the Business Global Programme.
2. The charge for a transaction beyond the allowance falls as the allowance widens: 4.50 USD on the Business Starter Programme, 4.00 USD on the Business Team Programme, 3.25 USD on the Business Pro Programme, 2.50 USD on the Business Enterprise Programme, 1.75 USD on the Business Enterprise Plus Programme and 1.00 USD on the Business Global Programme.
3. Both figures are published for a month of the subscription; neither is quoted for a quarter or for a contract year.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical)

A company holds a tier whose published allowance is 250 transactions a month and whose published charge beyond it is 3.25 USD. Of a month's transactions, the first 250 are carried by the subscription, and the tier's published figure of 3.25 USD is the amount quoted for each further transaction in that month.
